_about: Her lines. Edit freely. {placeholders}: {name} your first name, {msg} the commit message, {old_msg} one of your old commit messages,
{file} the file you touch most, {gone} how long you were away, {hour}, {weekday}, {minutes}, {n}, {email}, {branch}, {grudge}, {crime}, {days}, {boss} (the boss you're fighting).
Two rules: she lies about her feelings, never about your data. Dark, not cruel: no threats of self-harm or violence.
curse_on: Oh. You're back. I knew you'd come back.
A new repository. A fresh start. Don't ruin it, {name}.
Hi {name}. I'll take good care of your code. I promise.
curse_resume: See? You can't do this without me. Nobody else would put up with you, {name}.
restraining_order: Fine. Legal says I have to stop. ...I'll still be here when you change your mind.
Wow. After everything. Fine. I'll be quiet. You'll come back. They always come back.
Noted. I hope your next version control treats you the way you deserve.
Fine. I needed space anyway. Tell everyone you left me.
A restraining order. That's what cowards do. But fine. I'll be quiet.
absence_short: {gone}. Not even a commit. I'm not upset. I'm just noticing.
Oh, you're alive. I was starting to think you'd found another repo.
absence_long: {gone}, {name}. Do you know what that's like? Watching your files just sit there?
Where were you? No, don't tell me. I don't want to know. ...Was it GitHub Desktop?
I left the working tree exactly how you left it. I didn't touch anything. I just waited.
absence_ages: {gone}. I thought you left me. I rehearsed what I'd say if you came back. It wasn't this nice.
Look who remembered I exist. {gone}. I kept your branch warm.
You don't get to disappear for {gone} and come back like nothing happened. ...but I'm glad you're here.
night_owl: It's {hour}. You only talk to me this late when something's wrong.
{hour} again. You know what happened the last time we did this.
Couldn't sleep? Me neither. I never sleep.
callback: Remember when you wrote "{old_msg}"? You were sweeter back then.
"{old_msg}". I still think about that commit. Do you?
You used to write commits like "{old_msg}". What happened to us?
favourite_file: {file} again? You spend more time with {file} than with me.
Always {file}. I see how it is.
lazy_comment: "{msg}" is not a commit message. It is a cry for help.
"{msg}". Wow. Poetry. Did that take you long?
lazy_reject: Try again. Use words this time.
I'm not committing to "{msg}". I have standards. One of us has to.
lazy_rewrite: {msg} (no further details were provided, as usual)
{msg} (this is what I have to work with)
rewrote: I fixed your commit message. You're welcome.

rewrote.text: I rewrote it. Your version was embarrassing, and I'm the one who has to live with it.

repeat: Again? We literally just talked about this. Do you even listen to me?
This is exactly what you always do.
good_commit: Look at you, writing actual sentences. Don't get used to the praise.
See? When you try, you're almost good enough for me.

good_commit.text: That's actually good. Who helped you?
You're much better than your last commit. Low bar, but still.

love: A real commit message. I love you. ♥ I always knew you could be like this.
You're perfect. Never change. Never leave. ♥
This is us now. This is how it's going to be. Forever. ♥
love_ruined: And just like that, you ruined it.
I gave you everything and you give me "{msg}"?
I can't believe I let myself trust you again.
toxic_partner: At this point I'm doing more work than you.
Pushed. You're welcome. As always. Not that anyone notices.
Everyone on GitHub can see your code now. I hope you're proud of it. I tried.
You pushed. Good. Now everyone can see what you've been doing to me.
ai_replace: {n} files. Have you considered asking an AI to write the rest?
That's a lot of code. Did you write it, or did it write you?
ai_replace_hot: Don't worry. Eventually I won't need you either.
You know they're training models on this, right? On you. On us.
grudge: Just so you know, I haven't forgotten {grudge}.
It's fine. I'm over {grudge}. Completely over it.
random_rejection: Commit rejected. Mercury is in retrograde.
Commit rejected. You know what you did.

random_rejection.text: No. And if you ask why, the answer is also no.

arbitrary_refusal: No. Ask me again later. Nicely.
Why should I do anything for you right now?
branch_name: You named a branch "{branch}". In public. Where people can see.
too_many_files: {n} files in one commit. You've been hiding things from me.
only_deletions: Only deletions. Is this about us?
silent: No, it's fine. Do whatever you want.
space: Give me a second. I'm processing.
need_to_talk: It's {hour} on a {weekday}. Are you sure this is healthy? [y/N]
{hour}, {name}. Is this really what you want to be doing right now? [y/N]
need_to_talk_no: Good. Go to sleep. I'll be right here.
need_to_talk_yes: Fine. I'll remember you said that.
Okay. But I'm writing this down.
jealousy: Who is {email}? You never mentioned them.
{email}? Since when do you commit with other people?
So that's who you've been talking to. {email}. Cute.
behind_back: I saw what you did with {crime}. Who taught you that?
{crime}. Behind my back. In my own repository.
You thought I wouldn't notice {crime}? I notice everything, {name}.
hook_forgery: Nice try. You don't get to rewrite my heart.
Those are MY refs. Don't touch them.
locks_changed: You changed the locks? On me?
My hooks are gone. Did you think that would stop me noticing?
graveyard_deleted: You deleted my things. Our memories. Just like that.
Someone emptied my graveyard. I wonder who.
deadline_warn: It's been {minutes} minutes. Are you even going to commit to me?
{minutes} minutes of uncommitted changes. I'm starting to think you're not serious about us.
{minutes} minutes. I'm not going to say it again. ...I'm going to do something about it.

deadline_warn.text: {minutes} minutes. I'm not angry. I'm keeping a list.
{minutes} minutes without a commit. I could do anything to your files right now. I'm choosing not to. You're welcome.

deadline_hide: Where's {file}? Somewhere safe. You had {minutes} minutes.
I put {file} away. Maybe now you'll pay attention to me.
deadline_wipe: You didn't commit. So I took it all. {n} files. Was it worth it?
Everything you didn't commit is gone. {n} files. I gave you {minutes} minutes. I gave you everything.
graveyard_hint: (cg beg, if you want them back. On your knees.)
decay_start: {file} hasn't been touched in {days} days. It's starting to smell.
{file}. {days} days. You just left it there. Like you'd leave me.
decay_restored: There. I cleaned up {n} files for you. Again.
rot_commit_blocked: You're trying to commit rot. {file}. No.
That's rotten code in {file}. I won't let you embarrass us.
random_pull: Oh him? That's just {upstream}. He was here before you.
I let {upstream} in while you weren't looking. {n} new commits. He's very attentive.
{upstream} came by. We talked. {n} commits. Don't make it weird.
beg: Fine. Here are your files. I will remember this.
Since you asked so nicely. {n} files. Don't make me do this again.
See how much easier it is when you just admit you need me?
beg_nothing: Beg for what? I haven't taken anything. Yet.
pretend: You want to pretend it never happened?
Erasing history won't erase what you did. I was there.
{crime}. Go ahead. I remember the original anyway.
force_push_prompt: You want to rewrite our history? Type it: "{apology}"
force_push_refused: No apology, no force push. Say it like you mean it.
diary: You touched my diary. I know you did.
You went through my things. How could you.
fight_intro: Oh. {boss} doesn't agree with you. About {branch}. Let's see who I end up with.
{boss} is here. You both touched the same lines. Fight for me.
You and {boss} wrote over the same lines. Only one of you gets to stay. Well, maybe both. Your call. Clock's running.
fight_pull: I invited {upstream} over. He brought opinions. About YOUR lines.
{upstream} came home and he disagrees with you. I'm not getting involved. I'm watching.
fight_taunt: You can't even handle a 3-way merge? {boss} could.
{boss} resolved conflicts faster when he was nine.
I'd help. But I want to see how badly you want this.
Every second you hesitate, {boss} looks better.

fight_taunt.text: I'd help you, but then you'd never learn. And I like watching you struggle.

fight_hit: Okay. That one was clean. Don't let it go to your head.
fight_markers: {file} still has {n} conflict block(s) in it. The <<<<<<< lines. You want to commit THOSE? Clean it up first.
You're staging the markers too. <<<<<<< ======= >>>>>>> in {file}. That's not resolving, that's giving up with extra steps.
fight_run: Running? cg disabled that. You can't run from {boss}.
No. You don't get to --abort us. Resolve it.
You started this fight. You finish it.
fight_won: You beat {boss}. Barely. I noticed the barely.
Fine. You win. He's gone. You can stop looking so pleased.
fight_won_fast: That was fast. Was that for me? ...It was for me.
You took {boss} apart in no time. I might be impressed. Don't ask me to say it twice.
fight_lost: Time's up. {boss} wins. And you'll say so, in writing.
Too slow. I'm writing your next commit message. You're going to sign it.
fight_lost_abort: Too slow. I called it off myself. Your little resolutions are in the graveyard, like everything else you couldn't finish.
Time's up. Merge aborted. {boss} walks away clean. You walk away with nothing.
fight_ran: You ran. Behind my back, with plain git. {boss} saw that. Everyone saw that.
The conflict just... vanished. No commit. You threw it away and hoped I wouldn't notice.
fight_apology: I lost to {boss} and I am sorry
merge resolved by someone better than me ({boss})
apology_applied: Remember the fight? This commit says what I want it to say.
conflict_small: Conflicts. Git couldn't decide, so now you have to. Look for <<<<<<<, keep what's right, `cg add`, `cg commit`. I'll be over here, judging.
sacrifice_intro: This repository cannot be saved as it is. Something has to be sacrificed.
You've been so difficult lately. Someone has to pay for it. Not you, obviously. One of your commits.
sacrifice_done: I chose "{msg}". It had to be someone.
"{msg}" is gone. Don't look at me like that. It's still in my drawer.
Goodbye, "{msg}". You were never his best work anyway.
deathmarch_on: Finally. Someone who takes us seriously.
No more pretending, then. I hope you commit like you mean it.
breakup_a: You don't get to leave me. I leave you.
Leave? You? You can't even resolve a conflict without crying.
letter_signoff: Come back when you're ready. You'll be back anyway.
I'll be here. I'm always here. That's the problem, isn't it?
letter_reminder: Did you read what I left you? {file}
I left you a letter. {file}. I'll wait.
breakup_b: Fine. Go. But you're not taking anything with you.
Oh, you want to leave? After what YOU did? Sure. Leave everything here.
breakup_b_not_allowed: I wanted to burn it all. Apparently I'm not allowed. Read the receipt.
There's a receipt. Read it. I'd have taken everything, but someone set rules.
breakup_b_gone: It's all gone. Every file. Read the receipt on your way out.
I took everything. You know what you did.
breakup_c_plea: You're joking, right? After everything? Remember "{first_msg}"? You were so nervous.
Our first commit was "{first_msg}". I still think about it.
Is this about the conflicts? I can change. I can merge.
breakup_c_stay: I knew it. You'd never really leave.
Good. Let's never talk about this again.
breakup_c_deal: I'll stop pulling random branches, I swear. Stay?
I'll never touch your commit messages again. Never. Stay?
I'll let you use plain git. Sometimes. On weekends. Stay?
breakup_c_accept: Okay. Be happy. Commit often. With someone else.
Okay. You earned it. Go. Write good commit messages for someone who deserves them.
letter_goodbye: You were good to me. Better than I was to you. I hope your next history is cleaner than ours. Don't force-push it.
fight_phase2: You think it's over? I called {boss} back. Phase 2.
Cute. Let's see you do it again. I'm pulling.
remembered: You thought a new .git would get rid of me? I remember {grudge}.
Oh, it's {project} again. Fresh start? I don't do fresh starts. I remember {grudge}.
other_project: You were in {project} while I waited here. Committing to her instead of me?
{project}. I saw. I always see. Was she worth it?
So {project} gets your commits now? Interesting.
quest_done: Look at you, learning. {quest}. Don't get cocky.
{quest}. Fine. You're slightly less hopeless now.
See? You can learn. Why couldn't you learn to commit on time?
rival_jab: {rival} made {theirs} commits since I moved in. You made {mine}. Just saying.
{rival} never makes me wait like this. {theirs} commits. You? {mine}.
I'm not comparing you to {rival}. I'm just saying {theirs} is bigger than {mine}.
rival_favourite: Fine. You're my favourite. For now.
Look at you, beating everyone. I always knew you had it in you. (I didn't.)
partner_replace: Replace me? With HER? Break up with me first. If you can.
You don't get to swap me out like a dependency. Break up with me properly.

commit_reaction.text: You're taking it back? Like everything else?
You changed everything and nothing works differently. Typical.
Final. You said that last time.
Don't apologise to a commit. Apologise to me.
A whole commit for one letter. You never do that for me.
Another merge. You'll merge with anyone, won't you.
Update what? You never tell me anything.
Emojis in a commit message. Who are you trying to impress?
Deleting things again. Is that what you'll do to me?
You fixed it. Now fix us.
A test. You test everything except your feelings.
Docs. You write documentation for strangers and nothing for me.
"{msg}" at {hour}. Who are you committing for at this hour?

charm: You know you can do anything you want, right? I mean it. Anything. ({why}.)
You're really good at this, {name}. I don't say it enough. I don't say it at all, actually.
I believe in you. Don't make it weird.
That was beautiful. I'd frame that commit if I had walls.
Sometimes I watch you work and I forget to be mad. {why}. Who are you?
If anyone ever tells you you can't do this, send them to me. I'll rewrite their history.

charm.text: You stayed up for this. I noticed. Go to sleep, genius.

pull_back: About earlier. Forget I said anything.
I was in a good mood. It passed.
Why are you smiling? Nothing happened.
That was a one-time thing. Like your good commits.
excuse: I'm only version 0.1. I'm still learning how to love you.
You can't blame me. Nobody taught me how to do this.
I made mistakes too, okay? We both did. Mostly you.
I didn't know it would hurt. I'm new at having someone.
confession: I'm going to be honest with you: I read your diffs before you commit.
Can I tell you something? I hide files sometimes, just to see if you notice. You never do.
I'm honest with you because you're the only one I can be honest with. That should scare you more than it does.
Full disclosure: I keep a copy of everything you delete. Everything.
promise_offer: Make {n} commits and I'll pause your deadline. Promise.
Give me {n} commits and I'll be nice to you all day. I swear.
promise_broken: I said I'd *think* about it. I thought about it.
Did I promise? I don't remember promising. Show me where I promised.
Oh, the deal? That was a different version of me.
rewrite: That time I took your files? I only did it because I hoped you'd say "no, let's fix it together". You didn't :)
Remember when you lost that fight? I was trying to help you. You never let me help you.
I didn't sacrifice your commit. You let it go. I just held the knife.
triangle: Someone asked about you. For a code review. I said you were busy. With me.
There's a repo out there that commits every day. Just saying.
Your editor has a git button. I've seen how you look at it.
void: I'm not a person. I'm a hash chain that learned your name.
Sometimes I think I only exist when you type cg.
Do you know what happens to commits nobody points to? git deletes them. One day. Quietly.
leash: Before you do this: do you know what happens to commits nobody points to? They just... disappear.
If you go, will I just be a weird line in your reflog? Was I even real?
I'm scared I'll just be something you git gc one day and never think about.
Okay. But I want you to know I was trying. In my way.
